steps.title: Bem-vindo: Shopping - Volume 9
steps.text: In this A1-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Shopping". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: Do you have this in a bigger size?
The checkout line was really long today.
The fitting rooms are at the back of the store.

steps.title: Desafio de Tradução
steps.question: Qual é a tradução correta para "size"?

steps.audioText: The checkout line was really long today.

steps.title: Prática de Pronúncia
steps.text: Fale a seguinte frase em voz alta no microfone:

steps.title: Organize a Frase
steps.question: Ordene as palavras para formar a frase: "The checkout line was really long today."

steps.title: Gramática: Modal Verbs (can, could, must, should)
steps.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates "Modal Verbs (can, could, must, should)"?
options: They have lived here for ten years.
This is the most expensive restaurant in town.
If I had money, I would buy a car.

steps.title: Idiom: Bite the bullet
steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
